settings.heading: How can we help today?
settings.text: Look up an order, start a return or browse answers on shipping, discounts, Shelf Club, gift cards and recycling.

settings.question: How soon does an order leave?
settings.answer: Orders are packed within 48 hours. Anything placed after one on Friday afternoon goes out the following Monday.

settings.question: Can I change an order after paying?
settings.answer: No. Once placed, an order can't be edited or cancelled, but you can return it later.

settings.question: How long do I have to return something?
settings.answer: Thirty days from delivery. Items must be unused or lightly used. Online returns cost $5; boutique returns are free.

settings.question: What can't be sent back?
settings.answer: Final-sale items, gifts with purchase, gift cards and anything bought with club rewards.

settings.question: Can I use two promo codes?
settings.answer: One code per order. Welcome codes and sale markdowns can't be applied after the fact.

settings.question: Do points expire?
settings.answer: Never. They stay put whatever your level does.

settings.question: How do I claim a reward?
settings.answer: At a boutique register, on the club page, or at the bottom of your online bag.

settings.question: What can go in the empties bins?
settings.answer: Small caps, pumps, tubes and wands. Aerosols, perfume bottles, nail products, toothpaste tubes and pouches can't be accepted.

settings.question: How many items earn points?
settings.answer: Ten points each, with a limit of twelve per boutique visit.

settings.title: Chat
settings.body: Every day, early morning to early evening Pacific time.

settings.title: Email
settings.body: Send a note with your order number for a reply the next business day.

settings.title: Boutique
settings.body: Walk in and ask an advisor, or book a free consultation.
